thread:
sam_sales: Quick sync — prospect (regional bank) wants BYO-KMS with hardware attestation and a tight maintenance window (2h monthly). They also asked for a network isolation diagram and a clear pricing delta for HSM egress. Can we scope?
tara_se: Can you paste the exact asks from the RFP? small bullets are fine.
sam_sales: Sure — copied from legal: 
• Customer-managed keys (HSM-backed) with key import via secure transfer
• Monthly rotation window: prefer 02:00-04:00 UTC, must be >99.9% availability outside window
• Offline escrow option for disaster recovery (air-gapped export)
• FIPS 140-2 level 3 or equivalent attestation report
• Network whitelisting and private peering; they cannot traverse public internet for KMS operations
• Cost model: show incremental pricing for HSM vs standard CMK + any egress charges
mohit_cryptoops: High-level: we support BYO-CMK via our key proxy. For HSM-backed keys we need an HSM connector in the VPC; customer KMS API calls go over private peering to the proxy. Rotation can be orchestrated by our operator jobs. 2h window is tight but doable if we can guarantee no rolling full-restart.
laura_ops: Important: automated rotations must preserve active KV caches — otherwise latency spikes. We usually do a KV-graceful key swap: 1) stage new key, 2) atomically switch references, 3) garbage collect old KV after TTL. That avoids global cache flushes.
dan_security: Two questions: how is key material imported? is it brought in via wrapped key blobs or live key ceremony inside the HSM? Also need to see the attestation format (cert chain) — some banks require vendor-signed quotes for key provenance.
sam_sales: They said: import via encrypted transport (SFTP with hardware token) or onsite ceremony if required. Attestation: "vendor-signed HSM attestation + serials + firmware hash."
tara_se: For the network diagram, here's a minimal sketch I usually send — can someone verify and convert to PNG?
```
Customer VPC (private subnet)
  ↳ VPC Peering / PrivateLink
    ↳ Redwood KMS Proxy (dedicated subnet, no public IP)
      ↳ HSM Connector (FIPS 140-2 HSM appliance or cloud HSM)
Redwood Control Plane (management, audit logs) — separate private channel
```
mohit_cryptoops: That looks right. Add a flow arrow: key import uses dedicated SFTP bastion that writes to HSM connector over encrypted link. No plaintext on disk.
dan_security: We'll need the HSM attestation sample file (PEM) and the manifest for firmware hashes. Also clarify whether we provide HSM hardware (managed) or the customer supplies it.
sam_sales: Prospect asked for both options: vendor-managed HSM (we host + manage) OR customer-supplied HSM (co-located). Need delta pricing.
jess_finance: I can model incremental cost. Quick ask: what's the expected throughput for encryption ops during peak? we bill HSM per-hour + per-op premium.
laura_ops: Typical encryption qps they gave in questionnaire = 350 qps peak (latency-sensitive). For that scale with HSM managed nodes, recommend 2 connector instances + autoscale buffer.
jess_finance: Thanks — I'll run numbers. Also need any additional outbound egress that we might incur when customer requests escrow export (airgap ops) — is that manual labor billing?
mohit_cryptoops: Escrow export is a manual procedure if they want physical export; it requires ops ticket and timeboxed work. We should offer a standard SOW line item for key-escrow and verification.
dan_security: One blocker: legal asked if keys ever traverse our control plane. Answer must be strict: control plane sees metadata only; key material never stored in plaintext in control plane. We should prepare a short paragraph for security questionnaire.
tara_se: I'll draft the FAQ blurb: "Redwood does not persist unwrapped key material in the control plane. BYO key import uses wrapped blobs that are only unwrapped inside the HSM connector in the customer's VPC or in a customer-dedicated HSM appliance."
sam_sales: Awesome. Can someone draft the pricing delta and SOW bullets by EOD tomorrow? customer wants it for their procurement review. Also attach the attestation sample and the network PNG. :pray:
jess_finance: I'll have a preliminary delta (monthly + per-op) and draft SOW by EOD.
mohit_cryptoops: I'll attach sample attestation and a checklist for import ceremony tomorrow morning.
dan_security: I'll add the security questionnaire snippet and a short attestation explanation.
kms-attest-bot: Automated note: attached example_attestation.pem to thread (s3://internal/kms/attestations/example_attestation.pem) :white_check_mark:
sam_sales: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll share the procurement timeline with the customer and loop back once we have numbers. :thumbsup:
